method: Same optimized binary and host; exact production full decode; each full-matrix large-input sample has one untimed warmup and one timed decode in its own process. Three samples per parser/fixture, alternating parser order by round. Tiny ordinary control uses ten warmups and 1000 timed decodes per process. File reads excluded from decode timer; VmHWM includes process, input read and warmup. No timing threshold or device claim.
